title: ACR MCP read_relationships Request v1
description: Input for the read_relationships tool: one canonical subject, optional relation types, direction, depth, time point and page controls.

kind.description: Subject kind, as returned by find_subjects.

canonical_id.description: Canonical id, as returned by find_subjects. Never build or guess one.

subject.description: The one subject whose edges are read. Take it from find_subjects. A subject you may not read and one that does not exist give the same answer.

types.description: Relation types to read. Omit it to read every type.

direction.description: out follows edges that leave the subject, in follows edges that arrive at it, both follows either. Default both.

depth.description: 1 reads the subject's own edges; 2 also reads the edges of its visible neighbours. Default 1. 0 means not set (the default applies).

as_of.description: RFC 3339 time point. Omit it to read current edges.

limit.description: Edges per page (1 to 100). Default 50. 0 means not set (the default applies).

cursor.description: The page.next_cursor of the previous page of the same request. Send the same other fields.
